summary: Shoshone County lookout: 1916 crow's nest with cabin, 1934 50-foot pole tower, destroyed 1961; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1961 according to both lookout pages.

events.note: 50-foot pole tower; the pages word it as an L-4 cab or an L-4 tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives a pole tower with an L-4 cab; firelookout.com gives a 50' pole L-4 tower. Both give 50 feet and 1934, so the design is recorded as a 50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab, and the story reports the wording difference.

notes_for_editor: Do not merge with us-id-goat-mountain: that record is the Boundary County Goat Mountain (Kaniksu National Forest, cupola cabin 1924, destroyed 1965), a different lookout. The record's location conflict is open: the FFLA list gives 46.99262, -115.84718 and the Idaho Fire Lookouts map point is about 1.9 km away (47.00885, -115.83934). The story gives no coordinates. Two searches found no description of the site today; the story says so. Staffing is not documented by Idaho Fire Lookouts, so it is left out.
